license_summary.trapping_license: A Vermont trapping license is required to take animals with the use of traps (10 V.S.A. section 4252). Fees (10 V.S.A. section 4255; VFWD sporting license application): Resident trapping $23.00; resident youth trapping (17 & under) $10.00; resident 5-year trapping $109.00; nonresident trapping $305.00; nonresident 5-year trapping $1,519.00; nonresident youth trapping $305.00. Per the VFWD license application, trapping license eligibility requires proof of a previous license, a hunter/trapper safety card, or an affidavit.
license_summary.tagging_reporting: Bobcat, otter, and fisher pelts must be tagged (10 App. V.S.A. section 44, section 4.18): the taker must notify authorized Department staff within 48 hours of the close of the season and present pelts for tagging; tags remain affixed until the pelt is tanned; carcasses are surrendered at tagging; pelts may not be transported out of Vermont before tagging. Beaver and muskrat pelts carry no tagging requirement under section 44. ALL licensed trappers must complete and submit an annual biological collection trapper survey (trapping activity report) for the license season (section 4.23), and must report a trapped dog or cat to a warden within 24 hours of discovery.

verification.confirmation_notes: Verified 2026-11-15 against (1) the live VFWD Hunting and Trapping Seasons page and (2) the Furbearing species rule, 10 App. V.S.A. section 44, section 5.0. Rule formula dates converted to the 2026-27 calendar: fourth Saturday in October 2026 = Oct 24, 2026; second Saturday in October 2026 = Oct 10, 2026; second Sunday in February 2027 = Feb 14, 2027. Trapping: mink/skunk/red & gray fox/raccoon/coyote/opossum/weasel Oct 24-Dec 31, 2026; otter/muskrat/beaver Oct 24, 2026-Mar 31, 2027; fisher Dec 1-31, 2026; bobcat Dec 1-16, 2026; marten/lynx/wolf no open season. Hunting: bobcat Jan 10-Feb 7, 2026; red & gray fox Oct 24, 2026-Feb 14, 2027; raccoon Oct 10-Dec 31, 2026; muskrat Mar 20-Apr 19, 2026; skunk/weasel/opossum no closed season; coyote no closed season without dogs and Dec 15-Mar 31 with dogs (permit); mink/otter/beaver/fisher no open hunting season. All open furbearer seasons carry NO bag limit per section 5.0. All seasons are statewide (no WMU variation in section 44). License fees verified against 10 V.S.A. section 4255 and the VFWD sporting license application. Tagging/reporting verified against rule sections 4.18 (bobcat/otter/fisher pelt tagging) and 4.23 (annual trapper survey).
known_gaps: Scientific names are standard taxonomy and are NOT stated in the Vermont sources consulted; all remain scientific_name_verified=false (same convention as other finalized state files).

Bobcat hunting January 10-February 7, 2027: the standing rule (section 5.25) sets these dates annually, but VFWD's 2026-27 seasons page lists only the 2026 segment; the 2027 segment is documented in the hunting row's notes rather than modeled as a separate season entry.

The August 19, 2026 Fish & Wildlife Board packet discussed possible section 44 amendments (body-gripping trap sizing; extending the section 4.22 WMU E lynx-rule sunset from Jan 1, 2027 to 2032) but adopted none at that meeting; seasons, limits, tagging, and reporting verified here are the rule as in force for 2026-27.
